titles.name: The Initiate
titles.description: Chosen a base class and begun the journey through Xylos.

titles.name: Slime Slayer
titles.description: Defeated the Slime King and cleansed the sewers.

titles.name: The Veteran
titles.description: Reached Level 20 and advanced your class specialization.

titles.name: Echo Breaker
titles.description: Defeated the Resonance Echo and mastered the Outer Ring.

titles.name: The Master
titles.description: Reached Level 40 and achieved Master class status.

titles.name: Drake Hunter
titles.description: Survived battle against the legendary Ashen Drake.

titles.name: Harbinger Slayer
titles.description: Defeated the Abyss Harbinger and sealed the void.

titles.name: Titan Feller
titles.description: Felled the Gravity Titan and stabilized Xylos.

titles.name: The Legend
titles.description: Reached Level 80 with over 5000 power rating.

titles.name: The Eternal
titles.description: Reached Level 100. A living legend of Xylos, forever remembered.

titles.name: The Iron Banker
titles.description: Accumulated 500,000 credits through trade and conquest.

titles.name: The Warmonger
titles.description: Power rating exceeded 8000. Feared across all factions.

titles.name: The Explorer
titles.description: Explored 100+ times across the vast world of Xylos.

titles.name: The Renowned
titles.description: Earned 50,000+ reputation points across all factions.

titles.name: The Collector
titles.description: Filled inventory with 100+ unique items.

titles.name: Merchant Prince
titles.description: Completed 20+ successful trades.

titles.name: Finder of the Unlisted
titles.description: A repaired doorplate, returned with permission. An empty address is not an empty life.

titles.name: Reader Beneath the Paint
titles.description: Two legitimate marks preserved on one seal. Agreement is not the same as accuracy.

titles.name: Breaker of Empty Orders
titles.description: A retired municipal key, preserved as evidence of a failed register rather than a trophy taken from a resident.

titles.name: Keeper of Private Roads
titles.description: A ribbon used to refold a notice. Information can remain useful without becoming public.

titles.name: Witness Without Ownership
titles.description: A ring engraved with a doorway and no name. Recognition without possession.

titles.name: Hearer of the Missing Beat
titles.description: A discarded bell clapper. Its worth lies in the warning people finally heard.

titles.name: Reader of the Empty Line
titles.description: A civilian tool tag whose owner left through the proper safety exit.

titles.name: Ender of Repeated Failure
titles.description: A sheared cable ferrule kept to teach future repair crews what the failure looked like.

titles.name: Keeper of the Shared Shift
titles.description: A work token stamped by two suppliers. Cooperation on one shift does not erase their disagreement.

titles.name: Keeper of the Fourth Beat
titles.description: A loop braided from retired bell rope. It honors maintenance, not a borrowed military oath.

titles.name: Appraiser of Nothing
titles.description: A tare weight marked zero cargo. It distinguishes a valid storage fee from an invented shipment.

titles.name: Reader of Reversed Claims
titles.description: A shipping seal from a returned container; its orientation explains its record.

titles.name: Breaker of Circular Debt
titles.description: A fee seal invalidated for unauthorized use. A collector's misconduct is not a judgment on an entire port.

titles.name: Unfolder of Double Ledgers
titles.description: A ledger divider used to separate one service from two charges.

titles.name: Auditor of the Unseen Margin
titles.description: A signet bearing an empty crate. Earned by correcting a claim without condemning everyone who trades.

titles.name: Listener Before Believer
titles.description: A fork tuned to a damped rib. Its tone is an observation, not a divine translation.

titles.name: Reader of the Second Sound
titles.description: A token showing a bench turned away from spectacle and toward the sound's actual path.

titles.name: Keeper of a Measured Boundary
titles.description: A boundary cord from a limited field test. A useful result need not justify unlimited intrusion.

titles.name: Keeper of Honest Uncertainty
titles.description: A crystal carrying two measured intervals. Similarity is evidence; intention is not established.

titles.name: Warden of the Unanswered
titles.description: A pendant engraved with a measured pause. It honors the limits of a finding, not mastery of the Shard.

titles.name: Divider of Borrowed Histories
titles.description: A modern seal from an old chamber. Its custody date is not the chamber's age.

titles.name: Witness Before Judge
titles.description: A plate tracing the limit of heat damage. It records a pattern, not an accusation.

titles.name: Keeper of the Second Copy
titles.description: A clip used to keep two independently witnessed archive copies together.

titles.name: Reader of the Withheld Line
titles.description: An audit countertoken identifying a reserve without pretending the people waiting for it suffered no cost.

titles.name: The Unwritten Witness
titles.description: Five grooves surround an unfinished witness line. The final groove remains open for a correction not yet heard.
